memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Abdominal bloating and alternating diarrhea/constipation, mild discomfort.
  - Plan: Start mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS; advise low‑FODMAP diet, regular meals.
- Insomnia
  - Status: Difficulty falling asleep, frequent awakenings, daytime fatigue; ISI score pending.
  - Plan: Start melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS; sleep hygiene counseling.
- Polycystic ovary syndrome
  - Status: Irregular menses, acne, weight 58 kg, waist 78 cm (below female cutoff 80 cm).
  - Plan: Start metformin 500 mg BD, combined oral contraceptive pill OD; lifestyle modification.
Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2025-07-05).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 12.8 g/dL (12-16), WBC 6.2×10⁹/L (4-10), Plt 210×10⁹/L (150-400).
Stool routine: No ova, cysts or pus cells; normal consistency.
tTG‑IgA: Negative (<4 U/mL, ref <7).

memories.text:
Insomnia Severity Index: 14 (moderate).
TSH: 2.1 mIU/L (ref 0.4‑4.0).
HbA1c: 5.6% (ref 4.0‑5.6).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum testosterone: 48 ng/dL (female 15‑70).
LH: 6.2 mIU/L (ref 2‑12).
FSH: 5.0 mIU/L (ref 2‑12).
LH:FSH ratio: 1.2.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Pelvic ultrasound: Both ovaries enlarged with volume ~10 mL each. Multiple peripheral follicles (≥12 per ovary) seen. Endometrial thickness 6 mm, secretory pattern. No dominant cyst. Impression: Polycystic ovarian morphology consistent with PCOS.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling more tired during the day and still waking up 2‑3 times at night. The melatonin helps a little but I’m still sleepy in the mornings. My bowel symptoms are okay with the mebeverine.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Bloating reduced, stool frequency normal; no urgent episodes.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine, ispaghula husk, loperamide SOS; maintain low‑FODMAP.
- Insomnia
  - Status: Persistent daytime fatigue, night awakenings; ISI likely still >12.
  - Plan: Increase trazodone to 75 mg HS, keep melatonin 3 mg HS; advise limiting caffeine after 4 pm.
- Polycystic ovary syndrome
  - Status: Menses regular on OC pill, mild acne.
  - Plan: Continue metformin 500 mg BD, OC pill; consider referral for endocrine review.
Weight: 58.5 kg, Waist: 79 cm (still <80 cm).
Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2025-08-12).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
To: Dr. S. Reddy, Gynecology, Apollo Hospital, Bengaluru.
Reason: PCOS with persistent hyperandrogenism (acne) and need for expert opinion on long‑term management and fertility planning.
Enclosed: Recent pelvic ultrasound report, serum testosterone, LH/FSH, metformin and OC pill details.
Request: Advice on continuation of OC pill, lifestyle interventions, and timing for pregnancy planning.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
From Dr. S. Reddy, Gynecology:
Patient reviewed. OC pill appropriate for cycle control and acne; continue. Metformin beneficial for insulin resistance; continue. Recommend repeat pelvic ultrasound in 6 months to monitor ovarian morphology. Lifestyle: weight maintenance, exercise 150 min/week. No immediate fertility intervention needed.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up visit booked for 2025-09-15 at 10:30 am with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04). Please bring glucose log and any symptom diary.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Asymptomatic, no bloating or urgency.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine PRS, ispaghula husk daily, loperamide SOS only if needed.
- Insomnia
  - Status: Improved sleep onset, fewer awakenings; daytime energy better.
  - Plan: Trazodone 75 mg HS continue, melatonin 3 mg HS; review in 2 months.
- Polycystic ovary syndrome
  - Status: Menses regular, acne mild.
  - Plan: Metformin 500 mg BD continue, OC pill continue; repeat testosterone and LH/FSH in 6 months.
Weight: 58.0 kg, Waist: 78 cm.
Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2025-12-15).
